gist.headline: One more bee in the list
gist.blurb: zero2launch has been added to the GitHub identity list. The garden gate recognizes one more familiar face.
gist.summary: Added the GitHub identity zero2launch to the shared authentication allowlist used by Pollinations services.
gist.impact: The zero2launch account can now be recognized by the shared GitHub authentication configuration.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate with a small GitHub-style identity badge being added to a friendly roster. Polli, wearing a tiny gatekeeper cap, checks the new name beside code-plants and a softly glowing lime-green terminal.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing a tiny gatekeeper cap as she adds a GitHub identity badge labeled "zero2launch" to a garden gate roster beside a lime green (#ecf874) terminal and flowering code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and welcoming.
